hook_text: Four learners get R25 pocket money. One gets R200. 'Average' says R60. Who's lying?
clip_script: The mean is 300 divided by 5, R60 — but four of the five learners get far less than R60. The one large value, an outlier, pulls the mean up. The median, R25, describes a typical learner far better.
visual_style: Five coin stacks; one towers over the rest; a 'mean' line floats at R60 above four stacks; a 'median' line settles at R25.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to master mean, median, mode and range.
